text:
Maria (partnerships): quick sync request — ArdorTech wants a combined perf/W + thermal acceptance for marketplace onboarding. want to lock harness + telemetry schema + press embargo window. proposed: dry-run this week, signoff next tuesday.
Ajay (eng-ml): sounds good. what are the acceptance thresholds? perf/W target or delta vs baseline?
Nora (ardortech): our internal target is 12% perf/W improvement over baseline on p3-equivalent configs, no more than 10% sustained thermal throttling under 2hr soak. NDA covers detailed numbers, can share aggregate metrics for marketplace listing.
Linh (eng-runtime): for reproducibility we should standardize: model: gptx-4, seq=2048, batch=1/auto, load profile: ramp 0->100% over 15m, then 2h soak. telemetry must include per-socket watt, package temp, core freq, and KV cache hit rate.
Kevin (product): marketplace acceptance criteria need summarized fields only (avg perf/W, p95 latency, thermal-fails boolean). press: we need a 48h embargo after signoff — partner ok with that?
Nora (ardortech): 48h embargo ok. legal asked to avoid raw watt/time traces in public. aggregated CSV is fine.
Ajay (eng-ml): can we also include a simple quality gate: generation BLEU-like diff < 0.5% vs hosted baseline? avoids perf-only wins with bad outputs.
Linh (eng-runtime): agree. I'll add an automated eval step in the harness. sample command below for lab runs:
```bash
./run_harness --model gptx-4 --seq 2048 --runtime-profile soak --ramp 15m --duration 120m --metrics perf,watt,temp,kv_hits --eval-corpus /data/valset-small --telemetry-endpoint https://telemetry.redwood.local/ingest
```
Maria (partnerships): thanks. who will run the first dry-run and when?
Nora (ardortech): we can start on wed in our lab (UTC-8). we'll push telemetry to the agreed endpoint and tag runs with `ardor-rt1`.
benchbot: run 2026-03-25T18:32:12Z uploaded: summary -> avg_perf_w: 10.9, p95_latency_ms: 78, thermal_fails: 0, kv_hit: 0.73 :white_check_mark:
Ajay (eng-ml): nice. can you also dump kernel tuning vars used? we need to capture `sched` settings, CUDA kernel flags, and any gov tweaks.
Nora (ardortech): yes, we'll attach `kernel-config.txt` and `nv-kernel-flags.txt` to the run metadata. NDA limits sharing content externally but ok for internal signoff.
Linh (eng-runtime): for telemetry schema we need field names: `avg_perf_w`, `p95_latency_ms`, `thermal_fail_count`, `socket_power_w`, `package_temp_c`, `kv_cache_hit`. I'll push a small JSON schema to the repo before wed.
Kevin (product): once we have 1 full dry-run with passing eval + kernel config attached, I'll draft the marketplace listing copy and the joint announcement cadence. aim for internal signoff by next tuesday EOD.
Maria (partnerships): perfect. i'll coordinate legal + marketing for embargo language. action items: Linh schema + harness pr, Nora first lab run wed (tag ardor-rt1), Ajay to verify eval thresholds, Kevin to prep listing draft. any objections?
Nora (ardortech): none from our side. :thumbsup:
Ajay (eng-ml): no objections.
Linh (eng-runtime): on it.
Kevin (product): good to go.
Maria (partnerships): thanks all — i'll post calendar invite for signoff review (next tuesday 16:00 PDT).
